title: Douglas Group names Jean-Marc Bellaiche CEO
summary: Jean-Marc Bellaiche will commence his role with the company from 1 November 2026 for a term of four years, succeeding Sander van der Laan, who has decided to retire

title: Estée Lauder Companies and Reliance Foundation empower Indian women in new partnership
summary: Estée Lauder Companies’ initiative aims to help young women and girls strengthen digital and financial literacy and inform them about future pathways

title: Boots leads UK beauty market search ahead of Superdrug and Sephora
summary: New analysis by SEO agency MediaVision found that health and beauty retailer Boots accounts for a third of brand searches in the UK beauty market

title: DSM-Firmenich opens New York fine fragrance space
summary: The flavour and fragrance company’s new ‘open and immersive’ space in the Chelsea district of New York City, US, will bring together expertise ranging from perfumers to compounding capabilities
